description: This file implements Bluetooth L2CAP shell commands for Zephyr OS, providing functionalities such as connect, disconnect, send, receive, and manage allowlists for Bluetooth channels.

methods.name: l2cap_recv_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and updates the data rate metrics for a given L2CAP channel based on received buffer size and timing.

methods.name: l2cap_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback function scheduled to process received buffers from FIFO and confirm reception.

methods.name: l2cap_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming data on an L2CAP channel, optionally delaying response based on configuration.

methods.name: l2cap_sent
methods.description: Callback indicating data has been transmitted on an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: l2cap_status
methods.description: Reports the status of an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: l2cap_connected
methods.description: Handles actions upon establishing an L2CAP channel connection.

methods.name: l2cap_disconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup or actions upon disconnection of an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: l2cap_alloc_buf
methods.description: Allocates buffer for incoming data on an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: cmd_register
methods.description: Registers an L2CAP server with specified PSM, security level, and policy.

methods.name: cmd_ecred_reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures an ecred L2CAP channel with a new MTU.

methods.name: cmd_ecred_connect
methods.description: Initiates an ecred L2CAP connection with specified PSM and security level.

methods.name: cmd_connect
methods.description: Initiates an L2CAP connection to a specified PSM.

methods.name: cmd_send
methods.description: Sends data over an established L2CAP channel, with optional packet count and length.

methods.name: cmd_recv
methods.description: Sets or displays the receive delay for L2CAP data.

methods.name: cmd_metrics
methods.description: Enables or disables metrics collection for L2CAP data rate.

methods.name: cmd_allowlist_add
methods.description: Adds the current connection to the allowlist for L2CAP channels.

methods.name: cmd_allowlist_remove
methods.description: Removes the current connection from the allowlist.

methods.name: l2cap
methods.description: Main shell command for managing Bluetooth L2CAP channels.
